english translation text: O ASGHER! WHAT SHALL I DO

arabic text: HAYE ASGHAR KYA KAROON AY JANE MADAR KYA KAROON
english translation text: O ASGHER! WHAT SHALL I DO,\nO LIFE OF YOUR MOTHER, WHAT SHALL I DO

arabic text: THI YE BANO KI FUGHAN DUNYA MAY REH KAR KYA KAROON\nMAUT NE BARBAD KARDALA MERA GHAR KYA KAROON
english translation text: THE MOTHER USED TO CRY, WHAT SHALL I DO IN THIS WORLD\nDEATH HAS DESTROYED MY HOUSE, WHAT SHALL I DO

arabic text: HAI RAGE JAA KE LIYE HAR SANS NASHTAR KYA KAROON\nHASRATO KA DIL MAY EK BARPA HAI MEHSHAR KYA KAROON
english translation text: FOR MY LIFE, EVERY BREATH IS DIFFICULT TO TAKE\nA MULTITUDE OF HOPES IS IN MY HEART, WHAT SHALL I DO

arabic text: AY MERE NOORE NAZAR TUMKO AGAR PAUNGI MAI\nDEKHLENA RAAT BHAR SEENE SE LIPTAUNGI MAI
english translation text: O LIGHT OF MY EYES, IF I FOUND YOU\nWATCH HOW I WOULD HOLD YOU TO MY CHEST ALL NIGHT LONG

arabic text: SURK PHOOLON SE CHAMAN GULSHAN KE MEHKAUNGI MAI\nAB NA BHEJUNGI TUMHAY MAI GHAR SE BAAHAR KYA KAROON
english translation text: I WILL MAKE THE GARDEN FRAGRANT WITH RED FLOWERS\nTHEN I WILL LET YOU LEAVE THE HOUSE, WHAT SHALL I DO

arabic text: TUM SAMAJHTE HO YAHAN SE APNE GHAR JAUNGI MAI\nCHOR KAR TANHA TUMHAY BETA KIDHAR JAUNGI MAI
english translation text: YOU THINK THAT NOW FROM HERE I WILL GO HOME\nO SON! WHERE WILL I GO AFTER LEAVING YOU ALL ALONE

arabic text: QABR SE TAKRAKE SAR JANGAL MAY MAR JAUNGI MAI\nPHAYR LOON KYON NA GALE PAR APNE KHANJAR KYA KAROON
english translation text: I WILL DIE IN THIS DESERT BY YOUR GRAVE\nWHY SHOULD I NOT TAKE MY OWN LIFE, WHAT SHALL I DO

arabic text: KUCH NAHI TUMKO KHABAR SHEH KA MAKAAN LOOTA GAYA\nSAYEDDE ABRAR KA RAN MAY MAKAAN LOOTA GAYA
english translation text: YOU DO NOT KNOW YOUR FATHER'S HOUSE HAS BEEN LOOTED\nTHE HOUSE OF LEADER OF THE RIGHTEOUS HAS BEEN LOOTED

arabic text: DASHTE GHURBAT MAY HUSSAINI KAARWAN LOOTA GAYA\nAB NA AKBAR HAI NA ABBASE DILAWAR KYA KAROON
english translation text: IN THE DESERT OF HELPLESSNESS, THE HUSSAINI CARAVAN HAS BEEN LOOTED\nNOR ALI AKBER NOR ABBAS IS THERE NOW, WHAT SHALL I DO

arabic text: MAUT NE KHUD LORIYA DI NEEND LAANE KE LIYE\nRAN MAY AAYE ZALZALE JHOOLA JHULANE KE LIYE
english translation text: DEATH ITSELF SUNG LULLABIES TO PUT YOU TO SLEEP\nEARTHQUAKES CAME IN THE BATTLEFIELD TO ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: TUM CHALE MAIDAN MAY KAISE TEER KHANE KE LIYE\nAB TUMHAY TURBAT SE GEHWARE MAY LAAKAR KYA KAROON
english translation text: HOW YOU WENT INTO THE BATTLEFIELD TO BE HIT BY AN ARROW\nNOW WHAT IS THE POINT OF BRINGING YOU FROM YOUR GRAVE TO THE CRADLE
